name: Ring of Over Protection
body:
Aura faint abjuration; CL 5th; Slot ring; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This ring appears to be a ring of protection and functions as such. However, the ring’s magic also seeks to protect the wearer from harming himself in any way. As a result, all attack rolls and Strength and Dexterity-based skill checks are made at a -1 to -5 penalty (depending on the level of protection the ring imparts).

This ring can only be removed by the casting of remove curse upon it. Doing so allows the wearer to remove the ring, though the enchantment remains intact.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Magic Items ring of protection

Identification DC 30
False Identification DC 20
